missing_pieces.duty: assessment_dispute: ED26-P15-CH-systematic-power-C007 partial: thm:p15-power-source-examples (handbook/parts/p15/systematic-power.tex 159-194; annex 167-268) gives the s(T,K)=1/3 illustration and the K1-K3 regroupings (175/252). It leaves out other Hempel-Oppenheim examples inside the cited pp.164-173: (1) the L1 normal-form illustrations: minimal and maximal normal forms of P(a), of P(a)->Q(a), and of formally true and formally false sentences, with m_U=2,1,0,4 (pp.166, 168-169); (2) the L2 example: 8 atoms, 256 minimal sentences, and a 128-conjunct normal form of P(a) (p.166); (3) the non-singular consequence (Ex)(P(x)vQ(x)) of the minimal sentence P(a)vQ(a) (p.166). None appears elsewhere on the route.
